prose: Joe Lonsdale - Palantir and 8VC cofounder, and an Anthropic investor - said AI companies are attempting to sway public policy by warning of existential AI risks, per Reuters. A notable alignment: an Anthropic investor publicly undercutting the doom framing that Anthropic itself has amplified. (Summary based on the Reuters excerpt; the original article is paywalled.)
highlights: Lonsdale: AI firms warn of existential risk to sway public policy
He co-founded Palantir and 8VC - and invests in Anthropic
An Anthropic investor undercutting doom framing is the story's edge
Summary based on the Reuters excerpt; original paywalled
